timecoded_text_to_speech.text: Many companies and organizations use neural networks to solve various tasks, such as medical
diagnosis, financial analysis, autonomous driving, and more.
Researchers are also currently working on developing more efficient methods for training
neural networks, including methods based on genetic algorithms and meta-learning.
Neural networks are also used in the field of artificial intelligence, where they can
perform various tasks, such as controlling robots, creating intelligent agents, and more.
